jobs.title: Part-Time Retail Ambassador - Fifth Avenue
jobs.description:
RETAIL AMBASSADOR - PART-TIME

New York City, NY - Fifth Avenue

At Rothy’s, we believe there’s a better way to do business—one that puts the planet and its people first. That’s why we’ve transformed millions of plastic bottles into stylish, sustainable shoes and bags, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.

In our retail stores, clienteling, and genuine connection are at the heart of everything we do. We take pride in building lasting relationships with our customers—getting to know their style, anticipating their needs, and creating personalized experiences that make them feel truly seen and supported. Whether it’s helping someone find their perfect fit or sharing the story behind our sustainable designs, every interaction is an opportunity to deepen that connection.

As we grow, we’re cultivating not just a workplace, but a community. It’s a place where careers can grow, ideas are shared, and people feel a true sense of belonging. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, lead, and make an impact—together, as part of a welcoming, inclusive team that celebrates each other’s contributions.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (90%)

 - Deliver the Rothy’s Experience to every customer—a best in class service experience rooted in Rothy’s values—consistently embodying the brand through presentation, communication, and product expertise

 - Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior

Operational Excellence (10%)

 - Execute assigned responsibilities accurately as part of daily store operations, including stock replenishment, visual merchandising support, and store organization and cleanliness

 - Demonstrate knowledge of store operations and policies, following established procedures and SOPs to ensure operational excellence and compliance




YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older




YOU HAVE:

 - Previous retail or customer service experience preferred

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build genuine customer connections

 - A passion for service and the drive to achieve personal and team sales goals

 - Willingness to support operational tasks as part of the team

 - Availability to work at least 16 hours/week, either 3 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) OR 2 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) + 2 Non-Peak Days (Mondays - Thursdays)

 - Ability to stand/walk an entire shift

 - Ability to lift, push carry or otherwise move up to 25 lbs

 - Ability to frequently bending, reaching, stretching, and safely use ladders and step stools

 - Ability to uphold Rothy’s Experience by following our dress code, including wearing Rothy’s shoes during every shift




OUR BENEFITS:

 - Wellness and Commuter Programs

 - PTO and Wellbeing Time

 - Employee Discount Program




PAY RANGE:

$18.00 - $19.00 per hour

Base pay is one part of the total rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.  This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

Base pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

jobs.title: Enterprise Logging Solution (ELS) Engineer - Junior, Mid-Level & Senior [U.S. Citizenship & CBP BI – High Trust Required]
jobs.description:
Start Your Adventure at Via Logic

Location: Primarily onsite at a government site in Ashburn, VA. Specific worksite expectations will be confirmed for the assignment.
Type: Full-time, W-2
Compensation: $112,000–$159,000 annually, depending on experience, qualifications, and assignment
Experience: Junior: 3+ years; Mid-Level: 3+ years; Senior: 5+ years of relevant experience

Anticipated annual salary ranges by level are:

• Junior: $112,000–$125,000

• Mid-Level: $120,000–$148,000

• Senior: $127,000–$159,000

Reliable security monitoring starts with reliable data. Join Via Logic supporting U.S. Customs and Border Protection cybersecurity operations, where you’ll help keep enterprise logging systems collecting, processing, and delivering the information security teams need to protect critical systems and networks.

As an ELS Engineer, you’ll maintain log collection infrastructure, configure log sources, monitor logging system health and performance, and help develop and test log parsers and correlation rules. You’ll also support troubleshooting, system onboarding, dashboards, and improvements that make security data useful to analysts, system owners, and government stakeholders.

We are hiring for multiple openings across Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior experience levels through this posting. We’ll consider the depth and relevance of your experience, technical capabilities, and ability to work independently when identifying the opening that fits your background.

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

Due to CBP requirements, applicants must:

• Be a U.S. citizen.

• Be able to obtain and maintain the required CBP BI - High Trust background investigation and suitability determination, including applicable credit history review, for access to government facilities and systems.

• Be available to work primarily onsite at a government site in Ashburn, VA. Specific worksite and travel expectations will be confirmed for the assignment.

Please include any current or prior federal suitability or background investigation status when applying. We’ll confirm the applicable access requirements for the specific opening.

Your Mission

Responsibilities will vary by experience level and assignment, with Junior engineers contributing under guidance and more experienced engineers taking greater ownership of technical work.

• Maintain enterprise log collection infrastructure and support the health, performance, and reliability of ELS and SIEM platforms.

• Configure, onboard, and maintain log sources so security teams can monitor systems, applications, networks, endpoints, and cloud environments.

• Troubleshoot log collection, processing, connectivity, and ingestion issues, including interruptions to existing data feeds.

• Develop, test, and maintain log parsers, correlation rules, signatures, and other security content.

• Support the collection and aggregation of data from sources such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, endpoint tools, proxy servers, DLP platforms, cloud services, and vulnerability scanners.

• Create and maintain dashboards that support security monitoring, system oversight, and audit reporting.

• Support testing and implementation of approved logging enhancements in on-premises and cloud environments.

• Identify gaps in logging coverage, platform capabilities, and supporting processes, and recommend practical improvements.

• Support streaming data processing capabilities used for log onboarding, ingestion, and analysis.

• Extract and analyze relevant log information to support security investigations and operational requests.

• Maintain technical documentation, onboarding procedures, implementation plans, and support workflows.

• Collaborate with security analysts, system owners, engineers, and government stakeholders to resolve issues and support approved changes.

What You Bring to the Expedition

• Relevant professional experience in enterprise logging, SIEM administration, security engineering, systems administration, or related technical work.

• Experience configuring, maintaining, or troubleshooting log collection infrastructure, data sources, or security monitoring platforms.

• Understanding of how logs move from source systems through collection, processing, and ingestion into a centralized platform.

• Ability to investigate technical issues involving data feeds, connectivity, configuration, or platform performance.

• Familiarity with log parsing, search queries, correlation rules, dashboards, or similar capabilities used to interpret security data.

• Experience maintaining technical documentation and communicating implementation or troubleshooting steps clearly.

• Ability to collaborate with technical teams and explain findings, impacts, and recommended next steps.

We are considering candidates at three levels:

• Junior - 3+ years: You bring relevant technical experience and can contribute to log-source configuration, platform monitoring, routine troubleshooting, testing, and documentation with guidance from more experienced engineers. You can follow established procedures, document your work, and recognize when an issue needs escalation.

• Mid-Level - 3+ years: You bring demonstrated depth in enterprise logging or security monitoring and can independently carry out assigned log onboarding, configuration, troubleshooting, and platform improvement work. You can investigate ingestion issues, develop or refine parsers and correlation rules, and coordinate technical changes with other teams.

• Senior - 5+ years: You bring deeper experience supporting enterprise logging environments and can resolve complex collection, processing, ingestion, or platform issues. You can contribute to technical assessments and implementation plans, recommend improvements to reliability and logging coverage, and provide technical guidance to other engineers.

Junior and Mid-Level openings share a 3+ year experience threshold. The distinction is the depth of your hands-on experience, the complexity of work you’ve handled, and your ability to deliver independently.

Preferred qualifications:

• Hands-on experience administering or engineering enterprise SIEM and logging platforms.

• Experience developing log parsers, correlation rules, dashboards, or security monitoring content.

• Experience onboarding logs from cloud services, network devices, endpoints, applications, or security tools.

• Experience with scripting or automation to support logging operations and troubleshooting.

• Experience supporting streaming data pipelines, high availability, or multi-site logging environments.

• Experience implementing changes through established testing, configuration management, and change control processes.

• Experience supporting federal systems, security audits, or logging compliance requirements.

Tell us where you have the strongest experience and which areas you want to develop further.

Your Route Into Via Logic

One posting, three experience levels. Tell us about the logging platforms you’ve supported, the data sources you’ve worked with, and the onboarding, troubleshooting, or engineering improvements you’ve contributed to.

Why Explorers Stay

• Healthcare coverage and paid time off that give you room to take care of life outside work.

• Teammates who share knowledge, pitch in, and help each other grow.

• Opportunities to deepen your specialty and explore adjacent areas of cybersecurity as new assignments open up.

• Meaningful work protecting systems that support a federal mission.

How We Work

• These positions work primarily onsite at a government site in Ashburn, VA. Specific worksite and travel expectations will be confirmed for the assignment.

• You’ll collaborate with Via Logic teammates, government partners, security analysts, system owners, and other technical teams using tools approved for your work environment.

• The task’s weekday coverage window is generally 7:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Individual schedules and any on-call or surge support expectations will be discussed before moving forward.

• When virtual meetings are part of the work, we expect active participation and use video when appropriate and permitted by the client environment.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We believe different perspectives strengthen teams, improve innovation, and help us build better solutions for the missions we support.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. Due to the rise of fraudulent recruiting activity across the industry, we encourage candidates to use caution if something feels unusual, rushed, or too good to be true. Real adventures should involve solving meaningful challenges - not wiring money to strangers pretending to be recruiters on the internet. If you have concerns about the legitimacy of a communication claiming to represent Via Logic, please verify the information through our official website before sharing personal information or taking further action.

PREDAJNÝ PORADCA/PREDAJNÁ PORADKYŇA

ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.

• Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.

• Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.

• Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.

• A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).

• Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

• Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.

• Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.

• Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• 25 %zamestnanecká zľava na všetky značky v rámci H&M Group, v predajniach aj online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories a ARKET).

• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Viac o programe sa dozviete tu.

• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,

• Športová karta Multisport,

• Atraktívna mzda a ďalšie príležitostné bonusy.

• Rozsiahly program školení,

• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),

• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,

• Občerstvenie na pracovisku,

• Bonus pri narodení dieťaťa v podobe darčekovej karty v hodnote 50 eur,

• Po odpracovaní 10 rokov dovolenka naviac,

• Odmena za odporučenie kolegu až do 300 eur,

• 4 dni Relaxing Days (2 v prvom roku zamestnania).

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​

Ide o pozíciu na skrátený pracovný úväzok v rozsahu 30 hodín týždenne. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, s nerovnomerne rozvrhnutou pracovnou dobou, pričom sa pracuje na ranné aj poobedné zmeny počas pracovného týždňa.

Miesto výkonu práce je v Nitre.

Mzdové ohodnotenie je 6,18 € brutto/hod., vrátane príplatku za víkend nad rámec zákona.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 10.10.2026.

Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­­­­­­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na  recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

jobs.title: Senior Territory Manager, Independent Agency Channel - Kansas City MO Territory
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRANCH

Branch is on a mission to make insurance more accessible, so more people can be covered. We innovate using data, tech, and automation to simplify insurance from start to finish—we eliminated inaccurate quotes in favor of real prices, created a better way to bundle, and cut unnecessary costs in the traditional insurance process. Then we pass those savings along to our members. Basically, we’re doing insurance the way it was meant to be.

But we didn’t just create the insurance we’ve always wanted, we also created the company we’ve always wanted to work for. As we redefine insurance, we also want to redefine what it means to work in insurance. Find out for yourself.

Branch has a preference for candidates in Ohio, but is open to candidates located in AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, KY, MD, MI, MO, NV, NC, OH, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, and WI. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Branch is remote first, with most Branchers choosing to work from home. Our headquarters are located in Columbus, Ohio, where we come together from time to time to build relationships and connect with each other in real life. We also have office space in Columbia and Concordia, Missouri as well as Forreston, Illinois. Once a year, the entire company gathers for “BranchFest”, a highlight of the year for many Branchers.

About the role

Branch’s Senior Territory Manager owns a defined state (or set of states) and grows the volume and quality of business submitted by independent agencies in that territory. You carry a production target and are accountable for hitting it.

This is a relationship-first, feet-on-the-street role: you'll be the face of Branch to agency principals and producers, responsible for building trust, driving adoption of Branch's quoting tools, and coaching agencies toward writing business that fits our appetite.

The role replaces a remote, digitally delivered agency management model with an in-person, field-based one. Your presence in the territory is the product. You set your own call plan, decide where your time is best spent across your agency base, and defend those choices against your number.

The most successful Territory Managers are commercially direct. They are comfortable asking an agency for a commitment and holding them to it. They diagnose why an agency isn’t producing and they reframe objections around total value. They run a disciplined week without anyone telling them where to be and they bring what they hear in the field back to Branch in a form the business can act on.

This role sits at the center of Branch's IA go-to-market strategy and reports to the Director, Territory Management.

Key Responsibilities

 - Own the territory. Build and segment a target agency list OR Manage a segmented target agency list], and decide where your time goes - which relationships to build, which to rebuild, which to prioritize against your production target. You set and iterate on a territory plan; your manager reviews it.

 - Own the number. Carry a production target for bound premium and policy count in your territory. Maintain a pipeline view of appointed agencies, quoting trends, and bound premium by agency. Track against target throughout the period, flag haps early, and adjust your plan to close them.

 - Get in front of agents. Run and log a consistent cadence of in-person agency visits, lunch-and-learns, and local events to build face-to-face relationships with principals and producers.

 - Ask for commitments: Leave priority agency conversations with specific production commitments

 - Pitch Branch effectively. Clearly communicate Branch's frictionless value proposition, appetite, and differentiators and ensure target producers understand Branch’s core value.

 - Drive quality quoting behavior. Educate agencies on Branch's ideal risk profile so the business they quote binds, retains, and performs.

 - Champion staff-first quoting. Train the relevant stakeholders at agencies to quote in Branch's quoting platform before going into a comparative rater.

 - Activate and retain producing agencies. Grow the share of target agencies that produce with consistency, and re-engage those that go quiet.

 - Address objections directly. Regularly address objections agencies and shoppers may have, repositioning Branch as an ideal choice for their business

 - Report back on the ground truth. Transform what you're hearing in-territory - competitive intel, pricing friction, product gaps - into insights that inform broader IA strategy.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Underwriting, and Operations to resolve territory-level barriers to production.

How Success Is Measured

 - Growth: Bound premium and policy count from assigned territory, measured against target

 - Quality of business: % of growth against ideal customer profile (bundled home and auto customers with CovA between $400k-$1.2m)

 - Agent activation: % of target agencies actively producing with consistency

Skills, Knowledge, and Expertise

 - 5+ years in a quota- or target-carrying field sales role where you owned a defined geography or book of business. Independent agency distribution, territory/field sales, SaaS sales, or a comparable business development role preferred.

 - Demonstrated accountability to a specific production number.

 - Experience influencing the choices of independent professionals; your success depended on people choosing your product/service over alternatives, not on authority over them

 - Existing relationships with independent agencies in the assigned state(s) are helpful

 - Comfort and experience with managing a high-travel, self-directed field schedule

 - Strong in-person presentation and group training skills, with the ability to quickly establish credibility and rapport with agency principals and producers.

 - Consultative selling acumen; able to diagnose why an agency is/isn't producing for Branch and address the actual barriers and opportunities.

 - Demonstrated ability to learn a technical, regulated product well enough to teach it. P&C insurance experience is preferred but not required - we’ll train the product and expect command of underwriting appetite, rating, and agency workflow in the first quarter.

Why join us at Branch?

We’re all about getting back to getting each other’s back - that means Branchers, too. So we provide benefits that let you work and live to your fullest.

 - Above-market salary - Branch is a data-driven company, so we do the math on salaries, too. If you get an offer from Branch, you can expect compensation that hits above the mark.

 - Pay equity and transparency - Our pay isn’t just market-driven, it’s equitable. We let experience and performance drive your success, never your gender, race, orientation, or beliefs.

 - Remote-first (with perks) - Work from where you’re most comfortable. We’ll take care of your work from home set-up and monthly internet. We also have a Columbus headquarters if you’d like to join us in an office.

 - Flexible YouTime - We don’t just let you control your own time off.  We actually encourage you to use it. After your first year at Branch, we’ll give you $1000 toward your next vacation.

 - Employee stock options - You’re not just an employee. If you’re full-time, you’re also a part-owner. You’ll have stock options so you can invest in the company you’re helping to grow.

 - Medical, vision, dental - Get all the coverage you need for a healthy, happy life.

 - 401k and contribution matching - Invest in your future. Branch helps you get to retirement on time with a portion of your contributions matched each month.

What to expect

In light of recent hiring scams across the United States, here’s what the process will look like with Branch (so you know it’s us):

 - Please apply to open positions directly through our site. If you don’t see it here, then it shouldn’t exist on another job board. If you’re ever unsure about the legitimacy of a Branch  job posting found on another site, please check the listings here to verify.

 - If you're selected to move onto the next phase of the hiring process, a member of our Branch talent team will reach out to you directly from the email domain @ourbranch.com http://ourbranch.com to guide you through our process.

 - The process will include a number of interviews, which will all happen either over the phone or on video calls.

 - We will never ask for personal payment or require you to purchase equipment during our interview process. Always be sure to protect your personal information.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

At Branch, we are deeply committed to community. Branch is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants and/or employees will receive consideration for employment without regard to the individual’s age, race, color, religion or creed, national origin or ancestry, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetic information, ethnicity, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Accommodations
Branch provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the role. To request one, contact people@ourbranch.com.

The Medical Assistant reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Medical Assistant is a member of the health care team primarily responsible for providing support to physicians, nurses, and other licensed medical staff by facilitating efficient patient flow, assisting with various patient care activities, and performing related administrative functions. The Medical Assistant is responsible for ensuring efficient patient flow through the clinic; maintaining neat, clean and safe patient care areas; promoting patient satisfaction by interacting with patients in a professional, friendly manner; safeguarding patient confidentiality.

Responsibilities:

• Assures efficient patient flow through the site: Escorts patient to exam room, identifies patient with 2 identifiers and prepares patient for examination. Obtains accurate vital signs, per organization standards. Documents reason for visit and updates/confirms, allergies, smoking history and pharmacy information. Promptly informs the provider and registered nurse of any significant change in vital signs or acute symptoms. Anticipates/sets up equipment or supplies needed for visit. Participates in environmental safety rounds. Maintains vaccine/medication inventory. Monitors and maintains equipment and instruments according to clinic guidelines. Assists in ordering supplies and correctly disposes of all expired items. Adheres to office opening and closing procedures.

Offers assistance to others. Attends and participates in staff meetings. Communicates appropriately and effectively with patients and patient care team (in the office and on the phone)

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer — Ticketing & Travel Commerce
jobs.description:
Company Description

OleOle is building a global social network and messaging platform for football fans. Our mission is to create a single global community where supporters can follow their club and country, connect with other fans, message and call each other, follow live matches, discover content, and ultimately access a broader ecosystem of football products and services.

The OleOle platform combines social networking, encrypted messaging, live scores, video, multilingual content, payments, digital wallets, AI, and Mini Programs designed around the global football community.

OleOle Sport is one of OleOle’s core business units, focused on ticketing, VIP hospitality, and football travel. The business will provide access to hard-to-get match tickets, hospitality experiences, hotels, and complete travel packages for major football matches and sporting events around the world.

OleOle Sport will operate through its own standalone consumer website while also becoming an integrated Mini Program within the larger OleOle platform, connecting OleOle’s community directly to tickets, travel, hospitality, and payments.

We are now looking for a technical leader and Website Architect to take ownership of OleOle Sport’s technology platform. This is a hands-on leadership position for someone capable of architecting and building the website and underlying commerce platform, integrating ticket and travel inventory from multiple providers, and ultimately building and leading the engineering team responsible for OleOle Sport.

The right person will have significant experience building high-scale consumer commerce, travel, ticketing, booking, reservation, or marketplace platforms and will be comfortable owning the technology from architecture through production.

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technical leader who can take ownership of OleOle Sport from architecture through production. The right candidate should be comfortable operating as both a Website Architect and senior individual contributor, making critical technical decisions while personally building significant parts of the platform.

• 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience at Staff, Principal, Lead, Architect, or equivalent level.
• Proven experience architecting and building high-scale consumer transactional platforms.
• Strong preference for direct experience in travel, ticketing, hospitality, reservations, booking platforms, marketplaces, or complex e-commerce.
• Hands-on experience designing systems involving inventory, availability, pricing, reservations/orders, checkout, payments, fulfillment, cancellations, refunds, and reconciliation.
• Experience integrating multiple external suppliers, vendors, APIs, payment providers, or inventory sources and designing abstraction layers that avoid dependency on any single provider.
• Strong understanding of transactional reliability, including idempotency, retries, concurrency, inventory holds, partial failures, asynchronous workflows, reconciliation, and recovery.
• Deep full-stack engineering experience with modern consumer web technologies. Experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Java, Go, Rust, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, AWS, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies is valuable.
• Experience designing highly available systems capable of handling significant traffic spikes and high-value transactions.
• Strong understanding of security, authentication, payment security, observability, testing, CI/CD, and production operations.
• Experience with international and multilingual consumer products is highly desirable.
• Experience architecting large-scale SEO or programmatic SEO platforms, including SSR, structured data/schema, canonical URLs, hreflang, internal linking, sitemap architecture, crawl/indexation management, and web performance, is a major advantage.
• Production experience with AI/LLM systems, agents, tool/function calling, recommendation systems, or AI-assisted content/data platforms is also valuable.
• Ability to work closely with OleOle’s CTO, payments architecture leadership, product, design, and other platform teams while maintaining clear ownership of OleOle Sport.
• Ability and desire to remain deeply hands-on. We are not looking for someone who only manages engineers or produces architecture diagrams.
• Experience recruiting, mentoring, and eventually leading a small, high-performing engineering team.
• Strong product judgment and the ability to take an early-stage business requirement and turn it into a production architecture without requiring a large organization around you.

Current Compensation Structure

OleOle is currently pre-funding, and this position begins under a written deferred-compensation agreement. This is not free work, volunteer work, or an unpaid internship. Compensation is earned and accrues from the beginning of the engagement and is paid once OleOle closes its funding.

Following funding, the position transitions to a normal competitive market salary plus equity and token ownership, giving the technical leader of OleOle Sport meaningful long-term participation in the business being built.

Our current team, including the founder and senior technical leadership, is operating under the same deferred-compensation model while we complete the funding process.

Solutions not problems .

• Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better!
• Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies.
• Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early-stage technology company
• An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro-management
• Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus

Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!

jobs.description:
The Director, Strategy will be a critical leader in supporting the growth and execution of Highwire’s strategy function. Reporting directly to the EVP, Head of Strategy, the Director will work cross-functionally to design and implement strategic frameworks that solve clients’ business, communications and marketing challenges. You will play a pivotal role in collaborating with internal teams and external clients to craft innovative, insight-driven strategies that deliver measurable results. You will guide the thinking of our account and specialist teams across earned media, content, social, influencer and creative, coaching and mentoring them through critical thinking, codifying and conveying their tacit knowledge of clients, industries and competitive landscapes, and working closely with our Insights and Analytics teams to create briefs which surround first-hand knowledge with data-driven insight. Your strategic direction will inform and guide all our work, from the development of overarching creative platforms to deeply integrated channel activation plans.

This role will support new business efforts, guide the execution of client engagements, and ensure strategic excellence across the board. The Director, Strategy will partner closely with Highwire’s Digital, Strategic Communications, Creative, Analytics & Insights, and Account teams to deliver fully integrated campaigns and grow the strategy function.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Framework Development:

• Support the creation of experience and engagement strategies that align with clients' business objectives, working with various internal teams (e.g., Creative, Digital, Analytics).

• Assist in driving the value story for brand experiences and strategic projects, ensuring alignment with client goals and measurable outcomes.

Client & Account Leadership:

• Act as a co-leader on key accounts alongside client portfolio leaders, providing strategic counsel and ensuring the successful delivery of client objectives.

• Lead strategic discovery sessions, gathering insights and experience requirements to develop solutions that meet client needs.

• Partner with the Highwire Intelligence Group to ensure strategies are grounded in measurable frameworks and can be tracked for performance over time.

• Build and nurture long-term client relationships, contributing to business growth through exceptional strategy execution and insights.

New Business & Growth Support:

• Play a key role in the new business process, helping to develop engagement strategies and craft persuasive pitch narratives that resonate with prospective clients.

• Work closely with the business development team to pitch new ideas and expand Highwire’s client base, focusing on how strategic solutions can drive results.

• Identify opportunities for innovation within existing client relationships to expand the scope of strategic services.

Team Mentorship & Development:

• Mentor and guide junior strategists and team members, helping to elevate their strategic thinking, storytelling, and client engagement skills.

• Foster a collaborative and empowering team culture, encouraging creativity and innovation while maintaining high standards of execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

• Partner with cross-functional teams, including Digital, Creative, and Analytics, to ensure the seamless integration of strategy into larger client campaigns and initiatives.

• Ensure that strategy informs every aspect of client work, from creative ideation to execution, and that each project is aligned with overarching client goals.

• Work closely with the I&A and account teams to document requirements, gather insights, and develop comprehensive strategic roadmaps.

Success Factors

• 6+ years of experience in strategic communications, marketing, or related fields, with a proven track record of leading successful client engagements.

• Demonstrated ability to create strategic frameworks and deliver integrated solutions that address business challenges.

• Strong client-facing skills, with the ability to build and nurture senior-level client relationships.

• Experience working across disciplines, including digital marketing, creative, and analytics, to deliver comprehensive solutions.

• Proven success in supporting new business development, including pitching strategies and driving growth within existing accounts.

• Strong leadership and mentorship skills, with experience developing and guiding junior team members.

• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas to internal teams and clients.

• Collaborative mindset with experience working in fast-paced, client-driven environments.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field is preferred.

The salary range for this position is $110,000 to $135,000, with the final offer based on a combination of factors, including education, relevant experience, skills, prior training, internal equity, and local geographic market data. This role also includes a competitive benefits package with medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, generous paid time off, and additional perks designed to support your overall well-being and growth. #LI-Remote

About Highwire

Highwire is a strategic marketing communications agency at the intersection of innovation and industry. We partner with ambitious companies and established brands to navigate complexity, lead markets, and grow with purpose. With integrated expertise in strategic marketing and communications, corporate reputation, creative, and insights, we cut through the noise to deliver bold ideas and measurable impact across B2B technology, healthcare, cybersecurity, energy, professional and financial services, and more.

At Highwire, we believe that storytelling fuels transformation. We know that the most impactful stories represent all voices and perspectives. As a values-driven agency, we foster an inclusive environment where everyone—regardless of age, race/ethnicity, size, shape, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion and different abilities–can feel safe, celebrated and worthy.

We ensure that every Highwire Walker has the requisite support to soar in their careers. Our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging is foundational and embedded in our business and culture. We aspire to change our industry and build a better future for all.

Our people-first culture is driven by four core values:

• Team Empowerment

• Growth Mindset

• Inclusion Always

• Fierce Distinction

We’re looking for individuals with big ideas, strong opinions, and the energy to bring them to life. If you thrive in an environment that values personal accountability, high standards, and boundless motivation, this is the opportunity for you. Be part of our award-winning culture and contribute to an exciting and growing business where you can make a real impact.

Highwire. Above all.

Our people-first culture is reflected in the meaningful benefits, flexibility, and support we offer:

• Competitive salary with merit-based opportunities for growth

• Flexible hybrid work model tailored to your schedule and lifestyle

• Generous vacation policy, including extended summer and winter breaks

• Early log-off on Fridays through our Empower Hours program

• 401(k) plan with employer matching

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus FSA options

• Paid parental leave benefits

• Commuter benefits

• Annual Growth Mindset stipend for books, events, or learning experiences

• Monthly technology reimbursement

• Wellness benefit program for mental and physical health

• 501c3 donation matching program

• Mentorship and ongoing professional development opportunities

• Monthly recognition and team celebrations

• Employee referral and new business referral bonuses

• Quarterly Highwire events and team gatherings

• Dog-friendly office environment

• A supportive, inclusive, and collaborative workplace where you can grow and do your best work

Location & Work Environment

Highwire offers both remote and hybrid work options, depending on where you live.

Hybrid: Candidates located within commuting distance of our New York, NY or San Francisco, CA offices follow a hybrid schedule, with three in-office days per week.

Remote: We hire for fully remote roles in the following states: California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Washington, D.C..

Please note: We are only able to consider candidates who reside in one of the locations listed above at the time of hire.

Join the Highwire team

If you’re inspired by the opportunity to shape meaningful stories and grow alongside a team that values innovation, accountability, and inclusion, apply below to start the conversation.

Please note: This posting may be used to build our talent pipeline, connect with top professionals in the industry, or extend reach across multiple locations. We welcome all interested candidates to apply and explore opportunities at Highwire!

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Senior DevOps Engineer

Redwood Materials is looking for motivated and talented DevOps engineers to help architect, build, and deploy infrastructure and applications in a hybrid AWS and Kubernetes environment. These applications will cover use cases from web integrations with auto manufacturers to predictive machine controllers to new battery-based energy products. The ideal candidate is someone experienced with creating, managing, and supporting both AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes (self-hosted and AWS EKS based) using infrastructure-as-code tools. This is an opportunity to join during a critical growth phase and build green field software experiences and capabilities which will have a significant impact on the company’s day-to-day operations and ability to scale.

Responsibilities Will Include:

• Leverage existing in-house AWS architectures and design new ones where needed, using the CDK tool kit to manage and create AWS resources.

• Operationalize workloads in AWS and Kubernetes, helping to design and implement monitoring solutions and deployment pipelines.

• Enhance existing and implement new build/test/deploy automated pipelines.

• Partner with on-prem counterparts to drive hybrid infrastructure projects.

• Apply industry best practices (automation through infrastructure-as-code, security, etc.)

• Perform root cause analysis of production errors and resolve technical issues.

• Author and maintain detailed design documents and system architecture diagrams.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience.

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience as a DevOps engineer or in a similar software engineering role developing solutions in AWS.

• Similar hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes workloads.

• Solid knowledge and experience with AWS services: IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, VPC, DynamoDB, etc.

• Solid knowledge and experience with Kubernetes and containerization: configuring and managing clusters, helm chart development and deployment, building containers, working with docker, etc.

• Experience automating AWS solutions using infrastructure-as-code tools, such as CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.

• Fluency in Python strongly desired.

• Experience with Linux, Git.

• An understanding of security best practices, and the experience, to know when and where to apply them.

• Working knowledge of databases (relational and non-relational) a plus.

• Demonstrated ability to manage production workloads (debugging, monitoring, alerting).

Working Conditions:

• Infrequent night/weekend work if production systems are down and require immediate attention. (No formal on-call rotation; part of shared team responsibility.)

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.title: Patient Service Representative-Multi Specialty Full Time Days
jobs.description:
**This is a Full Time position at 40 hours per week for the Grayslake Multi-Specialty clinic. Schedule is Monday through Friday, 8:00am-4:30pm.**

The Patient Service Representative reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Medicine, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Patient Service Representative supports the service area by checking patients in and out of appointments. This role will consistently demonstrate exemplary customer service when assisting patients and guests.

Responsibilities:

• Communicates with patients and guests including greeting them upon arrival, confirming identity and providing necessary information related to their visit.
• Completes check-in/out functions as directed.
• Confirms and updates patient identification and demographic/insurance information.
• Completes patient registration as needed.
• Obtains patient consents/authorizations.
• Collects co-payments, past due balances and point of service payments.
• Posts payments, process billing information and perform “end of day” cash drawer closing.
• Keeps waiting area clean and comfortable.
• Informs patients of any delays or changes in appointment status.
• Schedules appointments as necessary.
• For PSRs in the Immediate Care Clinics (ICC), float to other ICCs/departments.
• May perform other duties as assigned.

Required

• High school diploma or GED equivalent.
• Zero (0) to two (2) years’ experience in a customer service position.

Preferred

• Bachelor’s degree.
• Previous experience in a healthcare setting.
• Working knowledge of medical terminology.
• Bilingual.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information

NorthwesternMedicine Career Page

https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

As Director of IT & Business Enablement, you'll own the systems, tools, and technology experience that power every team at Censys. Your mandate: make our internal tools fast, reliable, and easy to use — and make sure we're getting maximum leverage out of AI across everything we run. You understand that availability and usability are often in tension, and you know how to balance both without slowing the business down.

You'll own the full lifecycle of our internal technology stack — from endpoint provisioning and SaaS tooling to the adoption, integration, and optimization of AI across our systems. You're the person every employee turns to for equipment and tooling needs, and the person finance turns to for software utilization and budget decisions. You're energized by automating the boring stuff and building systems that act as force multipliers for the company.

jobs.title: Systems Test Engineer, IBCS-M
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Defense team builds robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, the Air Defense Team provides mission critical capabilities to warfighters. From detection to tracking, identification, deterrence, and defeat, our family of networked sensors and effectors enables our customers to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) threats. Working across product, engineering, sales, logistics, operations, and mission success, the Air Defense team develops, tests, deploys, and sustains the Anduril Air Defense Family of Systems (FoS) in challenging operational environments worldwide.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking to hire a Systems Test Engineer to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA. The Air Defense team has the most complex capability that Anduril has fielded to date. Each deployment often comes with a unique combination of hardware and software products in various configurations, targeting different mission sets, and optimized for different customer expectations. We need systems engineers who are capable of internalizing the nuances of each deployment and owning the technical success of the end-to-end solution we ship.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Lead the integration of emerging capabilities, bringing new products into the family of systems. This may include scoping and executing on a combination of hardware and software solutions, both internal and external to the company.

• Lead requirements decomposition across cross-functional teams, defining success in the face of ambiguity.

• Responsible for scoping ideal system laydown, scrutinizing system performance, and ensuring the deployed system is meeting customer requirements. Also responsible for making tradeoffs across capability, timelines, risk, cost, and other factors to deliver an outcome.

• Own systems end to end with the ability to identify and solve problems between the seams and push through to reach an ultimate outcome.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 1- 3 years of hardware and software systems engineering experience.

• Degree in Engineering, Physics, Robotics, Mathematics, or a related field.

• Demonstrated use of model based systems engineering in program lifecycle.

• Experience with tools such as: JAMA, Cameo, Matlab, Simulink, AFSIM.

• Experience with programming languages such as Python, C/C++, or Rust for analysis and simulation.

• Skilled in Statistics, AI/ML, MBSE, Requirements.

• Demonstrated proficiency in the application of engineering standards into engineering processes or requirements.

• Demonstrated experience collaborating across cross-functional teams.

• Comfortable working with ambiguity, evolving priorities, and challenging problems.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.

• Must be authorized to work in the United States.

• Up to 25% travel to customer sites.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with Linux OS. Comfortable obtaining data from software platforms using command-line tools.

• Previous experience in a defense, naval, or aerospace environment

• DO-178, MIL-STD-882E, Airworthiness or Compliance experience

• Experience with any of the following: robotics, autonomous systems, radar, optics, computer vision, wireless communication, software defined radios, networking.

• Experience designing test architecture for verification and validation campaigns

• Exceptional proficiency with Python and/or MATLAB for data parsing and data visualization.

• Experience working with CII, Jenkins or Automation pipelines

US Salary Range

$112,000—$149,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Engineer, Space PV Product Design & Prototyping
jobs.description:
At Tandem PV, we are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by bringing cost effective solar panels onto the market. We’re scaling metal-halide perovskite solar technology to make best-in-class mechanically stacked tandem modules.   We have built efficient, durable cells, monolithic multi-cell submodules, and packaged modules with our scalable, low-cost process. Our next focus is expanding our team to work in our new pilot manufacturing facility. 

Job Summary:

As a Senior R&D Engineer, Space PV Product Design & Prototyping, you will turn our perovskite cell technology into prototype space power products: lightweight, flexible photovoltaic modules and test articles for spacecraft, where the figure of merit is watts per kilogram rather than watts per square meter. You will own the product design, from module layout and electrical architecture through the laminate stack, interconnects, mounting and terminations, and you will build, test and iterate prototypes hands-on with our technicians and process team. You will also be the technical interface to component suppliers and to the external partners who perform environmental testing on your designs.

To be great at this role, you will:

 - Define prototype requirements with the program team (power, voltage, area, mass, stowage and operating environment) and translate them into design specifications and a verification plan.

 - Design module and coupon layouts: cell sizing and interconnect architecture, scribe and busbar patterns, string voltage and current, bypass and blocking protection, and terminations.

 - Design the mechanical build: laminate stack-up of cover, encapsulant, cell and substrate; edge seals; mounting to carriers, panels or flexible blankets; and harnessing and connectors, managing thermal expansion mismatch, stress and warp in low-stiffness structures.

 - Create and maintain CAD models, drawings, bills of materials, and mass and thickness budgets, and report performance in specific-power (W/kg) and areal-mass terms.

 - Build prototypes hands-on with technicians, and design the fixtures, jigs, masks and tooling needed to assemble, handle and test ultrathin and flexible parts.

 - Plan and run design verification (AM0 current-voltage, electroluminescence imaging, flex and bend, thermal cycling) and prepare pre-test baselines for external UV, radiation, vacuum and vibration campaigns; analyze failures and feed the findings into the next design iteration.

 - Work with process engineers to set design rules and tolerances that our cell deposition and laser patterning processes can reliably meet.

 - Own design documentation to design-review standard (requirements, drawings, DFMEA, build travelers and test reports), write build instructions and train technicians, and support government program reviews and reporting.

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of hands-on hardware or product design experience, including building and testing prototypes).

 - Degree in mechanical, electrical, aerospace or materials engineering, applied physics, or equivalent hands-on experience.

 - Demonstrated design ownership of electromechanical or photovoltaic hardware from concept through prototype build and test; you have taken a design through at least one full cycle of build, test, failure analysis and redesign.

 - Proficiency with 3D CAD (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo or Fusion) and engineering drawing practice, including tolerancing for thin, compliant parts.

 - PV electrical design fundamentals: series and parallel architecture, mismatch and shading losses, reverse bias and bypass protection, and current-voltage characterization.

 - Thermomechanical judgement: thermal expansion mismatch across dissimilar-material joints, stress and warp in thin laminates, and why a joint that survives terrestrial cycling may not survive an orbital one.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping
jobs.description:
At Tandem PV, we are a team of people who are passionate about building a more sustainable world by bringing cost effective solar panels onto the market. We’re scaling metal-halide perovskite solar technology to make best-in-class mechanically stacked tandem modules.   We have built efficient, durable cells, monolithic multi-cell submodules, and packaged modules with our scalable, low-cost process. Our next focus is expanding our team to work in our new pilot manufacturing facility. 

Job Summary:

As a Senior R&D Technician, Space PV Prototyping, you will work with our engineers and technicians to build prototype solar devices for spacecraft on ultrathin and flexible substrates: preparing substrates, running deposition, coating and patterning tools, laminating covers, and measuring results. Much of what you handle is a fraction of a millimeter thick and hard to replace, so careful execution, exact adherence to written procedures and meticulous records are central to the role. Your work produces the consistent, well-documented sample sets that our development and test campaigns depend on.

To be great at this role, you will have:

 - Clean, inspect, photograph and log substrates, and keep accurate inventory of limited, high-value materials.

 - Load and run sputter and evaporation processes, including bake-outs and controlled pump-down and vent sequences.

 - Coat and thermally process device layers to fixed recipes, and flag anything that looks different from previous runs.

 - Set up and run laser patterning steps, then inspect the result under a microscope and measure electrical isolation.

 - Laminate cover materials, including very thin ones, and inspect for voids and edge-seal quality; handle ultrathin substrates and release them from carriers once formally qualified.

 - Perform routine metrology: sheet-resistance mapping, transmittance, profilometry, optical microscopy, luminescence imaging and current-voltage measurement.

 - Keep run logs and per-part travelers (tools, recipes, temperatures, vacuum cycles, operator, timestamps), and prepare and ship sample batches to external test partners.

 - Build, label, mount and wire coupon sets for test campaigns and exposure chambers, and perform routine tool care, including early warning when a tool starts to drift.

 - Steady hands and patience for delicate manual work; this is the single most important qualification for the role.
