Job Description:

Start date -  June 2027

Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.

When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. This isn't a one-size-fits-all program; it's a personalized, two-year experience designed to cultivate your professional skills, enhance your business acumen, and hone your technical abilities. We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position.

During the two years, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey, covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops.

Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training, you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry.

Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs.  Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great. You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus.

Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world.

If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.

What you will be doing

You will be on a development journey to guide your growth into the role of Quality Conformance Manager (QCM) - Improvement and can expect to be involved in the following:

• Practical Problem solving or Root Cause Analysis for Non Conformities
• Protection analysis: understanding our Non conformities and Identifying proper means of protection
• Working with Multiple Quality programs for Global communication and tracking of Quality topics
• The Graduate will learn by the end of the program how to properly identify recurring trends in Non Conformities and host Practical Problem Solving sessions with a Multi Functional team to derive a Root Cause and Corrective action. The Graduate will obtain a world wide network with a broad understanding of how teams work in other Airbus Sites.
• By the end of the program the Graduate will be placed as a QCM Improver.

Your development journey will include a minimum of one rotational placement to support your growth into position.

At the end of the two year development programme, you will have developed into the position of Quality Conformance Engineering Manager!

What we are looking for

To be a successful applicant, you will need to demonstrate you have:

• A degree level or equivalent within Engineering in Aviation
• Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of Quality Conformance Management
• Strong verbal and written communication in our business language (English)
• A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation
• The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your development.
• Ability to work in the US without current, or future, need of visa sponsorship

Please note, we love your interest in working for Airbus but we do ask that you make only one application to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme. Take the time to decide which of our exciting opportunities is right for you and then submit an application that best represents you, your skills and experience in connection with the role you have selected.

Physical Requirements

• Onsite or remote: 100% Onsite
• Vision: able to see and read computer screen and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings.
• Hearing: able to hear and participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on production floor including safety warnings or alarms.
• Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications.
• Equipment Operation (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and related office equipment and using electronic identification card to enter building floors and internal doors): able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment and some tools including production tools such as hydraulic lifts.
• Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs.
• Lifting: able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs.
• Pushing / Pulling: able to push and pull small office furniture and some equipment and tools.
• Sitting: able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on computer.
• Squatting / Kneeling: able to squat or kneel to retrieve or replace items stored on low shelving.
• Standing: able to stand for discussions in offices or on production floor.
• Travel: able to travel independently and at short notice, potentially internationally.
• Walking (include routine walking such as to a shared printer to retrieve documents): able to walk through office and production areas including uneven surfaces.
• Personal Protective Equipment required: Required PPE includes, but is not limited to, Safety Shoes, Safety Glasses, Hearing Protection, Respirators/Masks, and/or Protective Gloves as required by site and/or customer site
• Administrative position only PPE required: Steel-toed shoes are required for all shop floor visit, appropriate hearing/eye protection may also be required when visiting the shop floor.

What is the recruitment process…

Online application -> Online Task Based Assessment -> Application Review (Talent Acquisition Partner & Manager) -> Virtual Assessment Centre -> Offer!

Please let us know if you need us to make any adjustments. Examples of this may include (but is not exclusive to) accessible facilities and additional time for written exercises etc. Any information disclosed will be treated in the strictest confidence.

jobs.title: Lead Photonics Validation Engineer
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/17/2026

Meet the Team

The Outshift by Cisco team is one of the Cisco’s most visible innovation organizations, driving the next generation of transformative technologies and business opportunities. You will collaborate with some of the company’s most forward-thinking researchers, engineers, and technology leaders. Within the Outshift Quantum Research team and Quantum Labs, we are pioneering the design and development of practical, scalable, and efficient quantum networking technologies — foundational building blocks for the future Quantum Internet. Our multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers is dedicated to advancing the state of the art in quantum networking, distributed quantum systems, and quantum-enabled applications.

Your Impact

Cisco Quantum Research is seeking a skilled Photonic Validation Engineer to support our Quantum Experimental Team in a role that is central to the physical realization of Cisco's deployable quantum hardware platforms. You will:

• Define and implement verification protocols to validate complex photonic and electronic performance metrics (e.g., entanglement fidelity, extinction ratios, dark count rates, coincidence counts, and insertion loss) under full system integration.
• Author clear, standardized test plans, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) protocols, Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) runbooks, and detailed performance reports that give external enterprise customers absolute confidence in our delivery.
• Act as the diagnostic bridge between hardware, optics, software, and systems engineering—pinpointing root causes of inter-subsystem anomalies, cross-talk, and signal degradation to drive design iterations.
• Play a key role in establishing the assembly and test infrastructure that will support the scaling of Cisco's quantum hardware platform delivery.
• Develop comprehensive test plans, validation matrices, and automated test scripts to verify both individual subsystem specifications and full-system multi-subsystem functionality.
• Build automated data acquisition (DAQ) and instrument control setups (using Python, LabVIEW, or MATLAB) to streamline routine testing of photonic switches, detectors, laser sources, and time-tagging/coincidence electronics.
• Establish reproducible baseline benchmarks for key quantum and classical metrics, ensuring long-term operational stability and repeatability across manufacturing units.
• Perform functional and parametric testing on standalone subsystems.
• Implement integrated multi-subsystem co-validation to identify complex issues such as thermal drift, RF noise pickup, optical back-reflections, clock synchronization offsets, and control logic timing race conditions.
• Author standardized Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) and Site Acceptance Test (SAT) execution procedures and technical sign-off criteria.
• Document, analyze, and present statistical test data, error propagation analyses, and pass/fail reports for engineering review and customer compliance packages.
• Maintain clear, traceable revision-controlled test logs, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and bug/issue tracking entries for hardware and software teams.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelors + 8 years of related experience, or Masters + 6 years of related experience, or PhD + 3 years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience.
• 2+ years of experience in test development, test automation, or hardware validation for complex optoelectronic, photonic, high-speed RF, or quantum systems.
• Experience writing code with Python or MATLAB for test automation, data analysis, and hardware instrument control.
• Experience with standard optical characterization equipment.
• Experience writing technical documentation, test protocols, FAT/SAT procedures, and validation reports.
• Experience reading, interpreting, and producing engineering drawings, schematics, and assembly procedures

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing electronics and control systems for lasers, electro-optic modulators, optical switches, photonic integrated circuits, or other photonic devices.
• Experience with precision timing, synchronization, and systems requiring tight latency control.
• Experience designing low-noise power distribution and electronics for sensitive instrumentation.
• Familiarity with high-speed data converters and interfaces such as JESD204B/JESD204C, Ethernet, and SFP-based interfaces.
• Experience with EDA tools such as Altium Designer or Cadence Allegro and signal-integrity/RF simulation tools such as Ansys HFSS, Keysight ADS, or HyperLynx.
• Knowledge of EMC/EMI design practices and UL/CE certification requirements.
• Experience designing electronics and cable/interconnect systems for rack-mounted instrumentation.
• Background in classical optics, quantum optics, quantum networking, photonics, or precision instrumentation.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Teller to join our National Branch Network. In this front line, customer focused role, you will support customers’ everyday banking needs through in-branch interactions, completing transactions accurately while delivering a welcoming and reliable experience. As a primary point of contact for customers, you represent the branch through strong service, attention to detail, and genuine care.

As a Teller, you will build foundational banking skills while learning about customers’ needs and introducing them to helpful products, services, and digital tools. You will identify opportunities to support customers and connect them to the right banker for more detailed product conversations. You will work closely with branch teammates to keep daily operations running smoothly and deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. This role offers meaningful exposure to retail banking and serves as an excellent starting point for long-term growth and career mobility, supported by Wells Fargo’s training, coaching, and team-based culture.

In this role you will:

• Deliver a positive and reliable branch experience by accurately processing transactions and engaging customers with care.
• Process routine service transactions (such as deposits, withdrawals, payments, and check cashing) with accuracy and attention to detail.
• Welcome customers, understand their needs, and guide them to efficient ways to bank, including digital tools, self-service options, or the appropriate team member.
• Build relationships, actively listen to understand everyday financial needs, and connect customers to relevant information, services, digital tools, or bankers.
• Identify potential product or service needs, introduce solutions at a high level, and refer customers to a banker for detailed guidance.
• Complete transactional and operational activities accurately, exercising sound judgment and managing risk in line with policies and controls.
• Use strong communication and active listening skills to clarify needs and provide clear, simple solutions or next steps.
• Collaborate with branch teammates to deliver strong operations and service, follow leadership direction, and escalate complex situations as needed.
• Resolve routine customer questions or concerns and escalate more complex issues to ensure timely resolution.

Required Qualifications:

• 6+ months of interacting with customers experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience in customer-facing roles, with strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately process transactions across multiple systems in fast-paced environments.
• Strong verbal communication and active listening skills, with the ability to understand needs, ask effective questions, and clearly explain solutions.
• Ability to follow policies, procedures, and controls while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
• Proven cash-handling experience
• Demonstrated ability to quickly build accuracy, confidence, and consistency in customer transactions.
• Professional, integrity-driven approach focused on building trust through reliable service.
• Ability to recognize potential risk, ask questions, and appropriately escalate concerns to protect customers and the organization.
• Ability to understand customer needs, identify referral and service opportunities, and educate customers on digital banking tools to improve convenience.
• Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with branch teammates to deliver a consistent customer experience.
• Organized and adaptable, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
• Ability to resolve routine customer concerns with sound judgment and professionalism.

Job Expectations:

• Ability to work a schedule that will include Saturdays
• This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship

Posting Location(s):

• 1459 Moreland Ave Atlanta, GA 30316

@RWF22

Posting End Date:

10 Oct 2026

*Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

About this role:

In addition, you’ll help customers with everyday banking needs-opening accounts, handling service requests, and ensuring a seamless experience making it easier for them to manage their banking with confidence. Success in this role is driven by strong relationship acumen, proactive customer engagement, and seamless collaboration with internal partners across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver a differentiated customer experience.

Wells Fargo rewards behaviors that consistently create long term customer value and support customers in making informed financial decisions. You’ll be supported with digital tools, industry leading training, ongoing coaching, and backed by one of the most recognized brands in banking. This role offers a clear platform for career growth for experienced professionals who excel at building trust, managing a portfolio, and delivering holistic, multi product solutions.

In this role you will:

• Proactively acquire new affluent consumer and business customers while deepening existing relationships through strategic outreach, referrals, and pre-planned customer appointments
• Lead discovery‑driven conversations to understand customer goals and deliver tailored banking and credit strategies that strengthen relationships, increase retention, and drive balanced growth across deposits, lending, and investments
• Serve as the primary financial partner delivering comprehensive, multi‑product guidance and ongoing reviews across life stages and evolving financial needs
• Partner with a team of professionals across Wealth, Home Lending, and Business Banking to deliver integrated solutions by coordinating warm introductions, setting clear expectations, and taking personal ownership to convert qualified opportunities into closed outcomes
• Champion digital adoption by educating customers on self-service and mobile banking options to elevate satisfaction, engagement, and service efficiency
• Serve as an active member of the branch team by advising colleagues on relationship development and the management of complex client needs
• Demonstrate risk excellence through accurate documentation, sound judgment, timely issue escalation, and adherence to policies and regulations to support strong control outcomes
• The Senior Branch Premier Banker LP (license pending) role is a temporary position until employee has successfully completed licensing requirements and SAFE registration. Upon successful completion, employees will transition to the Senior Branch Premier Banker (SAFE) role. Employees hired into the Senior Branch Premier Banker LP role who are not fully licensed will participate in the Branch Network Licensed Banker program.

Required Qualifications:

• 4+ years of customer service experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
• 3+ years of experience building and maintaining effective relationships with customers and partners
• 3+ years of experience recommending products and services

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience recommending financial products and translating customer goals into clear, actionable recommendations
• Demonstrated ability to proactively source, acquire, and deepen relationships through proactive outreach and building strong internal partnership to support the customer experience
• Proven experience managing a book-of-business, documentation of planning conversations, and consistent follow-through to drive retention and growth across deposits, lending, and investments
• Experience coaching or supporting peers to strengthen team performance and customer impact
• Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and confidently, listen with empathy, and build credibility and trust quickly with others
• Financial services industry experience in one or a combination of the following: consumer, home lending, business banking, or investments
• 3+ years of experience in a licensed financial services position
• Successfully completed Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA)Series 6 and 63 exams (or FINRA recognized equivalents) sufficient to qualify for immediate FINRA registration
• State Insurance license(s)

Job Expectations:

• Ability to work a schedule that will include most Saturdays
• This role requires FINRA Series 6 and Series 63 (or FINRA recognized equivalents), and State Insurance license(s) which must be active or completed within a designated timeframe. For any FINRA qualification exams earned after Sept. 30, 2018, the Securities Industry Essentials (SIE) exam is also required.
• For the following states where hired, FINRA Series 65 (or equivalent) examination will also be required within a specified period of time: AK, AL, CT, DE, HI, IA, ID, IN, KS, MD, MI, MN, MS, NC, ND, NE, NM, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, and WY. Wyoming allows referral-only licensed bankers to receive the IAR registration without the Series 65/66. Requirements may change based on current state regulations.
• Obtaining and maintaining required FINRA licenses is necessary for continued employment. This role also requires meeting enhanced financial fitness and criminal background standards. Wells Fargo will begin the FINRA review process once an offer is accepted.
• SAFE registration is required at the time of employment and Wells Fargo will initiate the process after your start date.Loan Originators must meet LO/CFPB requirements and comply with Wells Fargo policies, including standards related to financial responsibility, character, fitness, and criminal background. A credit report may be reviewed (credit score not included) and additional ongoing screening may apply.

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking accomplished, people‑focused leaders interested in a Branch Manager career within the National Branch Network. This opportunity is designed for experienced managers who bring a strong foundation in branch leadership and are looking to apply their expertise within the Wells Fargo environment.

As a Branch Manager, you will serve as the sales leader of the branch, accountable for acquiring, deepening and retaining customer relationships to drive consistent growth in primary checking, deposits, lending, credit cards and investments through disciplined execution, strong coaching, and effective performance management. You will lead, coach, and develop a team to consistently execute behaviors and improve banker productivity. You will foster an engaged, accountable culture focused on uncovering customer financial needs and recommending Wells Fargo solutions that deepen relationships and drive long‑term value. You will balance growth objectives with strong operational risk management to protect customers, employees, and the company.

Your onboarding starts with participation in the Branch Manager Readiness Program which is intended to offer a structured and supportive transition into leadership at Wells Fargo. Participants gain hands-on experience through guidance, mentorship, job shadowing, and practical learning opportunities in day-to-day branch operations. The program provides foundational knowledge, real-world practice, and leadership readiness needed to effectively lead a team and make an impact from day one. Successful completion of the Branch Manager Readiness program is required to transition into a Branch Manager position.  Branch assignment is based on business need and branch availability at the time of placement. While in training, this position is an interim, nonexempt role. Employees currently serving in a Branch Manager role at Wells Fargo are not required to complete the program.

In this role you will:

• Provide strong, inclusive leadership to build and retain a high‑performing team, establishing clear expectations, and managing performance through targeted coaching to deliver sales, service, and operational excellence.
• Lead a branch team to proactively identify customer financial needs and deliver tailored consumer and business solutions that drive both customer value and business outcomes.
• Use branch manager routines to build individual capability, confidence, and productivity, delivering consistent, high‑impact coaching through observation, feedback, and follow‑up while holding the team accountable to behaviors and outcomes aligned to Wells Fargo priorities.
• Partner closely with internal sales partners to provide customers a comprehensive, coordinated Wells Fargo experience across Wealth & Investment Management, Business Banking, and Home Lending to maximize relationship depth, customer value, and branch performance.
• Identify opportunities for making banking easier for customers through education and demonstration of available digital options.
• Leverage reporting and employee observations to gain insight into strengths and opportunities, taking decisive action to improve team performance and expand primary bank relationships and wallet share.
• Demonstrate ownership by balancing growth, operational soundness, and talent decisions while proactively managing risk, resolving issues, and modeling behaviors that protect customers, employees, and the company.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of banking, financial services, or Branch Network experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
• 2+ years of leadership experience

Desired Qualifications:

• Proven ability to hire, coach, and develop sales professionals and direct reports, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, adaptability, and high performance.
• Demonstrated ability to lead a customer-focused sales culture, driving measurable growth through coaching, accountability, disciplined execution, and taking ownership of performance outcomes, talent decisions, and risk management.
• Ability to analyze performance, identify strengths and opportunities, and execute action plans that enable the team to achieve business objectives.
• Exercise independent judgement and critical thinking skills to manage time, prioritize, and delegate tasks in a complex, fast-paced environment.
• Demonstrated success managing and coaching across affluent, high net worth, and business customer segments by identifying complex financial needs and building strong relationships with customers, internal partners, and community stakeholders.
• Ability to lead teams in influencing, educating, and connecting customers to technology, articulating the value of digital banking solutions to enhance customer experience.
• Knowledge of banking laws and regulations, including compliance controls, operational risk management, and loss prevention, with the ability to model and reinforce behaviors that protect customers, employees, and the company.

Job Expectations:

• Ability to work a schedule that includes Saturdays.
• Ability to travel in assigned geography up to 50% of the time during the first 6 months (and prior to or up until placement in a specific branch), depending on location.
• SAFE registration is required at the time of employment and Wells Fargo will initiate the process after your start date. Loan Originators must meet LO/CFPB requirements and comply with Wells Fargo policies, including standards related to financial responsibility, character, fitness, and criminal background. A credit report may be reviewed (credit score not included) and additional ongoing screening may apply.
• This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship.

Location:

jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Analytics Consultant. The role is essential to BOS’s shift toward an AI‑first, agentic Front Line Monitoring model, with LLMs and unstructured data analytics at the core. The role enables scalable use of LLMs, NLP, and agentic workflows to extract risk signals from qualitative data and reduce manual, judgment‑heavy processes. It provides the senior technical ownership needed to ensure explainable, auditable, and production‑ready AI adoption. Without this role, BOS faces delivery risk to its AI modernization agenda and delayed realization of signal‑quality and productivity gains already identified as strategic priorities

In this role, you will:

• Consult, review and research moderately complex business, operational, and technical challenges that require an in-depth evaluation of variable data factors
• Perform moderately complex data analysis to support and drive strategic initiatives and business needs
• Develop a deep understanding of technical systems and business processes to extract data driven insights while identifying opportunities for engineering enhancements
• Lead or participate on large cross group projects
• Mentor less experienced staff
• Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, external contractors, and mid-level managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
• Leverage a solid understanding of compliance and risk management requirements for supported area

Required Qualifications:

• 4+ years of Analytics experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

• Advanced hands‑on expertise in Python for analytics, anomaly detection, and scalable monitoring solutions
• Practical exposure to agentic AI and LLM usage for analytics acceleration or automation
• Experience working in GCP or cloud‑based analytics platforms
• Strong SQL skills with experience handling large, complex datasets
• Solid working knowledge of SAS within risk monitoring or regulatory environments
• Strong experience designing and reviewing visualizations in Power BI, Tableau, and Python
• Proven ability to lead end‑to‑end analytical solution design and guide junior team members
• Strong understanding of data modeling, feature engineering, and analytics architecture
• Prior experience driving analytics standardization or modernization initiatives

• Applicants must be amenable to work onsite.
• Applicants must be amenable to work on mid shift and night shift
• Lead the design, delivery, and evolution of front‑line monitoring analytics to detect conduct, operational, and compliance risks across BOS. The role will own end‑to‑end risk monitoring solutions that identify trends, anomalies, and outliers, driving improvements in monitoring coverage, consistency, scalability, and timeliness.
• The individual will lead complex analytical solutioning using Python, SQL, and SAS, overseeing data preparation, metric and feature design, anomaly detection frameworks, and visualization outputs.
• The role will provide technical leadership across multiple monitoring initiatives, ensure analytical rigor, and guide effective escalation and risk insights.

As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Are you inspired to work with a team than launches products with direct and massive impact on Amazon’s customers? Are you excited to join one of the newest and most exciting AWS services?

Amazon Connect is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them.
See our section in Andy Jassy 2020 re:Invent keynote

You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

As a developer on our team, you’ll own code end-to-end from design to development, and work closely with senior technical leaders within the team and across AWS. Project Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Production Test Engineer will support test operators and operations by coordinating, maintaining, and improving testing hardware and software capabilities for a variety of different propulsion subsystems: PCBAs, feed systems, electric propulsion thrusters, tanks, and integrated propulsion systems.

The Propulsion Test Engineer will support existing test processes and hardware in order to ensure the needed test coverage is achieved at production rates. This will include coordinating tests, training test operators, resolving test nonconformances, building up additional test stations, and implementing methods of optimizing testing.

Disposition and resolve test failures and flight hardware non-conformances
Improve test automation, data acquisition, and data analysis to improve test efficiency and cycle times

You will coordinate and support a variety of hardware tests of propulsion subsystems to ensure the hardware meets acceptance requirements for flight. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we're looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join the Automotive & Manufacturing organization within AWS Industries. In this role, you'll shape and lead our technology strategy for global automotive and manufacturing customers and partners, acting as a trusted strategic advisor to some of the largest automotive and manufacturing enterprises in the world. You'll drive the creation of long-horizon technology strategies that tackle complex, often ambiguous business challenges—showing customers how cloud adoption can fundamentally reshape their business outcomes and competitive standing.

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll serve as both a technical authority and a strategic influencer—bridging technology vision with measurable, long-term business value for automotive and manufacturing organizations. You'll bring deep technical expertise, executive-level business acumen, and the ability to influence technology strategy at the highest levels, engaging C-suite leaders, business decision makers, and senior technical executives to steer the direction of enterprise-scale cloud transformations.

You'll architect solutions to the most complex challenges—breaking down intricate, multi-system problems into elegant, scalable designs that become reference architectures for the broader SA community. You'll pioneer new architectural patterns and industry-specific methodologies (spanning Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, data platforms, and regulated workloads), and you'll shape the product roadmaps of AWS service teams by translating deep customer insight into clear engineering requirements. Working closely with account management, professional services, support, product teams, and the AWS partner ecosystem, you'll own the strategy for driving broad, lasting AWS adoption across your most strategic automotive and manufacturing enterprise customers.

Key job responsibilities
This role powers the success of AWS's most complex and strategic Automotive & Manufacturing engagements. As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll own solution programs end to end—from strategy to architecture to customer realization—driving measurable, lasting business impact. You'll operate with full autonomy, applying high judgment to decide where to invest your efforts for the greatest organizational and customer value.

A central part of the role is setting the technical and strategic direction for large-scale transformations—including AI/ML and Generative AI programs, data modernization, and regulated cloud migrations. You'll create reusable reference architectures, methodologies, and thought leadership—whitepapers, frameworks, and prescriptive guidance—that scale your impact across the SA community and the wider automotive and manufacturing market.

You'll act as a strategic advisor to your customers' senior leadership, earning trust at the executive level and shaping their long-term technology and business strategy. You'll anticipate emerging customer needs before they're fully articulated, ask the questions customers haven't thought to ask themselves, and lead the consensus-building required to align large, complex organizations around a clear path forward.

A day in the life
Mornings start deep in autonomy workloads—reviewing sensor-fusion pipelines and simulation-at-scale architectures with account's perception teams. Midday shifts to robotics customer: whiteboarding fleet telemetry ingestion, edge-to-cloud robotics data flows, and ML training infrastructure for locomotion models. Afternoons mean customer meetings, unblocking a stuck Kubernetes migration, and pressure-testing cost-optimization strategies. Between meetings, you prototype a reference architecture, mentor account SAs, and align with sales on a multi-year commitment. You close the day translating cutting-edge robotics ambitions into resilient, secure AWS designs—always one step ahead of what autonomous machines will demand next.

About the team
The AWSI Automotive & Manufacturing team is AWS's technical and strategic force behind the world's most ambitious mobility and industrial transformations. Spanning NAMER, APJ, and EMEA, the team partners with OEMs, suppliers, and robotics innovators architecting resilient, secure cloud platforms at scale. Solutions Architects drive migrations, modernize manufacturing data and ML workloads, and pioneer first-of-kind GenAI and autonomous deployments. Backed by specialist teams and relentless technical rigor, they translate bold visions for connected vehicles, smart factories, and intelligent machines into real, running AWS architecture—accelerating the future of transportation and manufacturing every single day.

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, SageMaker Training
jobs.description:
Interested in building the distributed systems that let customers customize foundation models at scale? The SageMaker Training and Model Customization team builds the services customers use to fine-tune and post-train models against their own accuracy, reliability, and cost targets. We are looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the team that owns those capabilities.

Model customization is the fastest-moving layer of the machine learning stack. Post-training has gone from supervised fine-tuning to reinforcement learning against verifiable rewards, and from single-turn tasks to agentic training where a model learns by acting in an environment over long trajectories. Each shift changes the shape of the workload: reinforcement learning puts an inference engine inside the training loop, and agentic training adds environments and tool calls that move the bottleneck from run to run. Your team turns each new technique into a capability customers can use, without rebuilding the platform every time the research moves. Underneath, it stays a hard distributed systems problem across large accelerator fleets where a single node failure can halt progression.

As the manager you own the team and its charter. You will hire and grow engineers, set technical direction with your senior engineers and product managers, and decide what the team does and does not build. You own the roadmap and defend its tradeoffs with leadership. You own the service in production, including on-call health, operational metrics, and the customer requests that come with a service in the critical path of customer training workloads.

Key job responsibilities
-Lead a team of highly skilled and driven individuals towards achieving critical business goals.

-Grow talent in the team, coach team members on growth areas and create a promotion paths for strong performers.

-Communicate clearly with our customers and collaborators to reduce ambiguity and mitigate risk.

-Enforce professional software engineering guidelines and best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations.

-Manage and communicate project deliverables, timelines, and progress.

-Build GenAI based distributed, multi-tenet systems with clear state-full/state-less boundaries.

A day in the life
Technical Leadership:

* Lead the design and development of Model customization capabilities on SageMaker Training.
* Own the technical vision for model customization infrastructure.
* Drive architectural decisions for scalable, resilient systems supporting foundation models

Team & People Management:

* Build, mentor, and grow a world-class team of software engineers and manage their career
* Hire top engineering talent and develop team members' careers
* Foster a culture of innovation, operational excellence, and customer obsession

About the team
We build the managed services customers use to customize foundation models. A customer brings a task, a dataset, and a definition of what a good answer is worth, and our services run the post-training loop on their behalf. We own that entire path, from the customer-facing API down to the training-session infrastructure.

jobs.title: Sr. Electrical Hardware Design Engineer – Mixed-Signal Sensor Systems
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

Group/Division

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics.   The SensArray® division leads in in-situ measurement and process control, helping semiconductor fabs and mask shops optimize yield and efficiency. Its solutions support both R&D and high-volume manufacturing, enabling automated process control (APC) through real-time thermal monitoring and analytics.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

At KLA, we develop advanced sensing and measurement technologies that help enable the world's most sophisticated semiconductor manufacturing processes. As a Sr. Electrical Hardware Design Engineer – Mixed-Signal Sensor Systems, you will play a critical role in the development of instrumented wafer products that integrate precision sensors, embedded electronics, power management, communications, and data acquisition technologies into highly constrained environments.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys owning technical problems, making design decisions, and working across disciplines to develop products from concept through production.

What You'll Do

• Design and develop mixed-signal electrical subsystems for advanced instrumented wafer products.
• Define electrical architectures and evaluate design tradeoffs related to performance, power consumption, reliability, manufacturability, and cost.
• Develop low-power analog and digital circuitry for sensing, measurement, and embedded applications.
• Select and integrate sensors, ADCs, microcontrollers, memory devices, batteries, communication interfaces, and power-management circuitry.
• Create schematics and drive PCB/substrate development through design reviews and release.
• Develop system-level performance requirements, error budgets, and measurement specifications.
• Define calibration strategies and support measurement traceability and accuracy requirements.
• Develop and execute validation plans, electrical characterization activities, and design verification testing.
• Lead technical investigations, troubleshoot complex hardware issues, and drive root-cause analysis.
• Collaborate closely with firmware, systems, mechanical, manufacturing, and product engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

• Degree in Electrical Engineering or related technical discipline.
• 3+ years of experience designing and developing electronic hardware products.
• Experience with mixed-signal circuit design including analog and digital electronics.
• Experience developing schematics and supporting PCB design and integration.
• Hands-on laboratory experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, DMMs, and other test equipment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience driving technical investigations and debugging efforts using root-cause analysis.
• Ability to independently execute subsystem designs with limited supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with precision sensor interfaces and analog front-end design.
• Experience with low-power electronics, battery-powered devices, or energy management systems.
• Familiarity with SPI, I²C, UART, RF, BLE, or optical communication interfaces.
• Experience with PCB design tools such as Altium, OrCAD, Cadence, PADS, or similar platforms.
• Experience using simulation and analysis tools such as LTspice, ADS, HyperLynx, MATLAB, or Python.
• Experience supporting products through development, qualification, and production release.
• Semiconductor equipment, instrumentation, robotics, aerospace, medical device, industrial automation, or embedded hardware experience.

What Success Looks Like

• Independently owns the design, development, and validation of electrical subsystems.
• Drives technical investigations and root-cause analysis for complex engineering challenges.
• Makes sound architecture and design tradeoff decisions within their area of responsibility.
• Leads small technical projects and coordinates work across multiple engineering disciplines.
• Identifies risks early and develops practical solutions to keep projects moving forward.
• Contributes as a trusted technical partner within a highly collaborative engineering environment.

Why Join KLA

You'll work on highly differentiated products that combine electronics, sensing, embedded systems, and semiconductor technology in ways that few companies can offer. This role provides significant technical ownership, exposure to complex multidisciplinary challenges, and the opportunity to directly influence technologies used by leading semiconductor manufacturers worldwide.

Minimum Qualifications

Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years

About KLA

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

jobs.title: Scientist- Cancer immunology/immunotherapy
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and hands-on Scientist- Cancer immunology/immunotherapy with experience in mammalian cell culture and a strong interest in cellular immunology to join our growing research organization. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, and execution of complex immune assays to identify and validate novel targets that support our immuno-oncology research programs. You will work with primary human samples, apply key immunological techniques such as flow cytometry and ELISpot, and generate high-quality scientific data that will advance our understanding of immune responses and inform the development of innovative therapies.

As a Scientist, you will be an integral member of a multidisciplinary team based in Boston, collaborating closely with colleagues across discovery and translational research. You will bring strong laboratory skills, scientific curiosity, and a collaborative mindset to support assay development, data generation, and scientific decision-making. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to novel immunotherapeutic approaches while continuing to develop your expertise in a dynamic and cutting-edge research environment.

Accountabilities

• Design, develop, and execute complex cellular immunology assays to identify and validate novel targets for cancer immunotherapy research.
• Perform mammalian cell culture, including maintenance and manipulation of primary human immune cells such as T cells and other patient-derived cell populations.
• Assess T cell activation, functionality, and immune responses using techniques including flow cytometry, ELISpot, and cell-based functional assays.
• Generate, analyze, interpret, and communicate experimental data in a clear and scientifically rigorous manner.
• Maintain detailed and accurate laboratory records in compliance with Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Safety, Health and Environment standards, and AstraZeneca policies.
• Collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams to share scientific knowledge and support project objectives across research programs.
• Contribute to the optimization and continuous improvement of assay platforms, methodologies, and laboratory workflows.
• Support the preparation of scientific reports, presentations, publications, and other documentation to communicate research findings.
• Stay current with advancements in immunology and related scientific fields and apply new knowledge to ongoing research activities.

Essential Skills/Experience

• Bachelor's degree, Master's degree, PhD, or equivalent experience in Immunology, Cell Biology, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, or a related life sciences discipline.
• Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.
• Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, including primary human immune cells such as T cells.
• Experience performing immunological assays, including flow cytometry (FACS) and ELISpot.
• Working knowledge of biochemical and cellular assay techniques, including ELISA and cell-based functional assays.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret experimental data and draw scientifically sound conclusions.
• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate laboratory records and documentation.
• Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
• Demonstrated enthusiasm for scientific learning and a proactive approach to acquiring new skills and knowledge.

Desirable Skills/Experience

• Experience working with patient-derived samples and primary human tissues.
• Knowledge of multi-parameter flow cytometry panel design, optimization, and analysis using FlowJo or equivalent software.
• Experience with high-content imaging, multiplex cytokine analysis, or other advanced immunological assay platforms.
• Understanding of antigen-specific T cell biology, cancer immunology, or vaccine research.
• Experience supporting translational research or biomarker discovery programs.
• Familiarity with experimental design, statistical analysis, and data visualization tools.
• Previous experience in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or academic research environment.

The annual base pay for this position ranges from $92,252.00 - $138,378.00. Our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short-term incentive bonuses, equity-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. jobs.title: Senior Accountant UK & Nordics
jobs.description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Bristol Myers Squibb | European Capability Centre

• Eligible for participation in the company’s annual bonus plan
• Family cover healthcare
• Attractive contributory pension scheme
• Hybrid working, 50% home / 50% office, giving you flexibility and balance
• 26 days holiday, plus bank holidays, plus festive shutdown
• Career and qualifications support, we invest in your growth
• Modern office with a range of on-site benefits, including on-site parking

What if your next accounting role actually felt significant?

Not just technically challenging but genuinely significant. The kind of role where you can see, in real terms, how the work you do every day connects to something far bigger than a balance sheet.

That's what this is.

We're looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Market Controllership team, based at our Chester office and if you're a finance professional who's built serious expertise over a decade or more and you're ready to step into a role with real scope, real influence, and real impact, this is worth your full attention.

So, what makes this role different?

Let's be honest, a lot of Senior Accountant roles promise "variety" and "exposure" and deliver spreadsheets and sign-offs.

This one is different. Here, you're not just supporting the business - you're a critical part of how BMS operates across the UK and Nordics markets. Your work ensures that the financial foundations of a world-leading biopharmaceutical company are solid, compliant and built for growth.

When you get the close right, when the audit runs smoothly, when a process improvement you championed saves the team hours every quarter - that's you. Visible, valued and making a difference.

What you'll be doing and why it matters

Owning the Numbers That Matter

• You'll oversee month-end, quarter-end and year-end financial closes - reviewing P&L and balance sheet analysis across UK and Nordic markets, working alongside our Legal Entity COE, Statutory COE and Hyderabad Capability Centre.

• This isn't just ticking boxes. When the financials are accurate and complete, leaders at every level of the organisation make better decisions - decisions that ultimately affect how BMS delivers life-changing medicines to patients. That starts with you getting this right.

Being the Person Auditors Trust

• You'll be the key liaison for both internal and external audits, as well as tax audits - managing relationships with auditors, tax authorities, and advisors with confidence and professionalism.

• There's a real career benefit here too: audit exposure at this level, across multiple markets and regulatory environments, is the kind of experience that genuinely sets you apart - and you'll build it here.

Navigating Tax and Transfer Pricing with Confidence

• You'll collaborate with the Tax COE and Corporate Transfer Pricing team to stay aligned on critical tax and TP positions and oversee Legal Entity profitability budgeting and quarterly profitability adjustment processes.

• If you've always wanted to broaden your technical expertise beyond core accounting into the more complex, commercially nuanced world of transfer pricing and international tax - this role gives you a front-row seat.

Shaping How Finance Works

• This role isn't just about maintaining what exists — it's about making it better. You'll identify and drive process improvement opportunities within Finance, and lead ad-hoc projects initiated by the Country and Regional Controllers.

• Your ideas will be heard here. When you spot a smarter way of doing things, you'll have the platform and the relationships to make it happen and you'll see the results.

Building Partnerships That Actually Work

• You'll work across a genuinely broad network - the Controllers Team, Corporate Treasury, Legal Entity and Statutory COEs, Capability Centres, and cross-functional partners throughout the organisation.

• This is the kind of cross-functional exposure that builds the commercial acumen, the stakeholder management skills and the organisational credibility that accelerates careers. By the time you've settled into this role, you'll have relationships across BMS that most finance professionals spend years trying to build.

Staying at the Leading Edge of Technical Accounting

• As part of BMS's Local Technical Accounting Network (TAN), you'll stay connected to the latest US GAAP and finance SOP developments - collaborating with Corporate TAN to ensure the business is always ahead of the curve.

In a world where accounting standards continue to evolve, this keeps your technical knowledge sharp and your professional value high.

What you'll bring

Your experience and qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred
• Professional qualification - CIMA, ACCA, CA or CPA
• 10+ years of experience overall, with at least 5 years in Finance in a global or multinational environment
• Pharmaceutical or life sciences industry experience preferred
• Strong knowledge of USGAAP, local GAAP, financial reporting standards and regulatory compliance
• Proficiency in SAP or equivalent ERP; familiarity with Blackline and Workiva a plus
• Proficiency in Microsoft Suite; knowledge of CoPilot and Power Automate desirable

Your strengths

• Technically sharp: You know your accounting standards inside out and you know how to apply them in a complex, multinational environment

• Naturally collaborative: You build trust quickly and work effectively across teams, time zones and functions because you genuinely believe the best outcomes come from working together

• Detail-conscious, big-picture aware: You maintain rigorous attention to accuracy while never losing sight of what the numbers mean for the broader business

• Process improver: You're never content with "that's how we've always done it" - you're always looking for the smarter, cleaner, more efficient way

• Analytically strong: You cut through complexity, synthesise information quickly and communicate your findings with clarity to the people who need them

• Adaptable: You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment - change doesn't unsettle you, it energises you

• Accountable: You take ownership - of your work, your relationships and your commitments - and people know they can count on you

Why BMS? Why now?

Because this is a company where the work you do in Finance is directly connected to a mission that matters transforming patients' lives through science.

You'll be joining a team that values expertise, rewards initiative and gives you the tools, the relationships and the space to grow. Based at our Chester office, with exposure across UK and Nordic markets and connection to a truly global finance function, this role offers the kind of breadth and depth that's hard to find anywhere else.

If you're ready to bring your best to a role that gives back just as much — we want to hear from you.

#LI
-Hybrid

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

How We Work

Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways-of-working.

Supporting People with Disabilities

BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. About the Role & Program:

The Operations Finance team is responsible for managing the financial and business affairs of the domestic Disney Experiences segment. In this role, you will gain valuable real-world finance experience as you learn the "why" behind business performance. You will have a proactive role in problem-solving on a results-oriented team in a collaborative environment.

• Collaborate within Operations Finance and Revenue Management teams to foster a deep understanding of the business to provide data needs, analytics, and actionable insights to drive business decisions.
• Generate reporting and ad-hoc analyses of historical and current data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities across multiple lines of business.

jobs.title: Host and Editorial Director, Business Insights
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Strategic leader to reimagine the content delivery, taking key insights and designing to meet the client in the ever-changing digital environment.  In addition, we are seeking a dynamic, credible, and highly engaging Host for a daily externally facing podcast serving CIOs, technology executives, and leaders navigating the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

This individual will become the face, voice, and personality of the program, translating the depth and breadth of Gartner’s insights and analyst expertise into timely, accessible, compelling conversations for an executive audience.

The Host will not be expected to be the definitive subject-matter expert on every topic. Instead, they will serve as the connective tissue between our analysts and our audience, drawing upon the insights, perspectives, and expertise of analysts across the organization to identify what matters, explain why it matters, and help executives understand what they should be thinking about next.

The ideal candidate combines the instincts of a journalist, interviewer, storyteller, curator, and executive communicator. They are intellectually curious, comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, confident engaging with highly credible experts, and able to establish a distinctive on-air personality that builds audience trust and loyalty over time.

Core Responsibilities

• Serve as the Face and Voice of the Podcast

• Host a high-quality reoccurring podcast designed primarily for CIOs and senior technology executives, with significant focus on AI and the rapidly changing technology landscape.

• Develop a recognizable and trusted on-air personality that makes complex topics engaging, understandable, and relevant to an executive audience.

• Establish continuity across episodes so the podcast feels like a consistent editorial destination rather than a collection of individual analyst interviews.

• Build an authentic relationship with the audience and ultimately become a recognizable external representative of the organization's technology insights.

• Curate and Deliver Across Four Editorial Pillars

• The Host will work with analysts, research leaders, and editorial partners to deliver programming across four primary areas: Event Driven | What's Happening Now; Top Insights | What We're Thinking; Client Perspective | What Leaders Are Asking; Market Positions | How the Market Is Moving

• Lead Compelling Conversations

• Interview analysts and other experts across a wide range of AI, technology, vendor, market, and other strong positions.

• Draw out the most interesting and differentiated insights from subject-matter experts.

• Challenge analysts constructively when appropriate, asking the questions an informed CIO would ask.

• Exercise Strong Editorial Judgment

• Work with editorial and research stakeholders to determine what deserves the audience's attention each day.

• Monitor emerging topics and quickly determine when developments warrant podcast coverage.

• Prioritize topics based on timeliness, executive relevance, differentiation, and potential audience value.

• Build Audience Engagement and Franchise Value

• Help establish the podcast as a must-listen daily destination for CIOs and technology executives.

• Partner with production, communications, social, and marketing teams to extend podcast conversations across channels.

• Use audience feedback and performance data to continually evolve the program, its format, and its editorial mix.

Candidate Profile

• Exceptional verbal communication, interviewing, and storytelling skills. Comfortable expressing personality, perspective, curiosity, and appropriate skepticism on air.

• Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with CIOs, senior technology leaders, and highly experienced analysts.

• Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and genuine enthusiasm for technology, AI, business, and markets.

• Ability to quickly absorb complicated research and turn it into clear, engaging conversations.

• Able to work at the pace required by a daily, event-driven publishing model.

Relevant Background

• 20+ years prior business experience

• Prior Gartner analyst experience preferred; experience in broadcast or podcast hosting; executive interviewing/discussions

• Experience working directly with AI, enterprise technology, business strategy, markets, or technology research is valuable. However, deep expertise in every technology domain is not required. More important is the ability to learn rapidly, prepare rigorously, identify differentiated insights, ask incisive questions, and make complex ideas useful to senior executives.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 208,000 USD - 261,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. jobs.title: Sr Analyst-Litigation
jobs.description:
Do your Best Work in Mooresville

This position is based at our headquarters in Mooresville, North Carolina. Our corporate office is a space where you can collaborate and do your best work. Take a walk, grab a bite (or a cup of coffee), work out or get a check-up – we invest in you so you can find your inspiration.

Your Impact

The primary purpose of this role is to serve as a risk claims analyst for the Legal department, handling litigated risks cases and sensitive brand issues. The Litigation Sr Analyst is responsible for conducting investigations and managing assigned litigation matters from pre-suit through resolution.  This includes gathering facts, evaluating liability and setting reserves, coordinating with internal stakeholders and outside counsel, and developing resolution strategies consistent with Company objectives and brand standards.

This role serves as an escalation point for the Claims team to assess case complexity, provide litigation guidance, and support jurisdictional and valuation analysis. The Litigation Specialist will have a working understanding of claim management and litigation.

What You Will Do

• Conduct thorough investigations of high exposure and brand impact claims by interviewing associates, store leadership, claimants and witnesses, reviewing video and documentation, and preserving evidence.
• Under the direction of in-house counsel, manage litigated matters, including coordination with outside counsel, developing case strategy, review pleadings, assessing liability and exposure, and setting reserves.
• Identify opportunities for early resolution and recommends litigation when appropriate.
• Establish and adjust reserves using sound judgment, analysis of claim exposure, and Company guidelines; authorizes payments within scope of authority.
• Coordinate claim defense efforts by collaborating with Store Operations, Asset Protection & Safety, and external vendors to ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely resolution.
• Develop and delivers training and lessons learned to internal business partners, focusing on litigation trends, best practices, and legal process awareness.
• Ensure claims are handled in compliance with legal requirements, internal policies, and service standards while preserving the Company’s reputation and brand integrity
• Provide open feedback and mentorship to team members to encourage growth and greater responsibility.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree Business Administration, Legal Studies or related studies or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education requirement, if applicable
• 6 Years Experience in risk and claims management and litigation
• 6 years of experience in risk, claim management, and litigation, including responsibility for managing litigation files and conducting investigations
• 5+ years demonstrated ability to analyze and manage ligation matters, including evaluating claims exposure, setting reserves, assessing risk, and developing resolution strategies
• 5+ years proven ability to manage a high-volume docket of litigation matters through all phases, including demand letters, pleadings and settlement
